{{short description|Iranian professor, chemist, scientist and inventor}}
{{Orphan|date=May 2020}}

'''Reyhaneh Sariri''' (born January 17, 1953) is an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] scientist, professor, and inventor. 

Sariri taught chemistry at the [[University of Guilan|University of Gilan]] and won The 2008 [[Royal Society of Chemistry#Prizes and awards|British Royal Society of Chemistry Award]] for her paper "on “Study of Antioxidant Effect of Fruits and Vegetables Special to Gilan.”<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.iranreview.org/content/Documents/Iranian_Professor_Wins_Royal_Prize_in_Chemistry.htm|title=Iranian Professor Wins Royal Prize in Chemistry|access-date=2018-07-27}}</ref> Sariri has published seven books and presented 148 papers at national and international conferences.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://en.civilica.com/modules.php?name=PaperSearch&queryWf=Reyhaneh&queryWr=Sariri&simoradv=ADV&period=all&ConfereceRes=1&JournalRes=1|title=Search Sariri|last=CIVILICA|first=سیویلیکا -|website=en.civilica.com|language=en|access-date=2018-07-27}}</ref>
